世尊 s1 o1: Continued Essentials of the Old Worthies; a raised historical account: at the assembly on Vulture Peak the World-Honored One holds up a flower, Kāśyapa smiles, and the World-Honored One says that he entrusts the treasury of the true teaching eye to Mahākāśyapa for transmission.

世尊 s1 o1 expected '續古尊宿語要': Continued Essentials of the Old Worthies; a raised historical account: at the assembly on Vulture Peak the World-Honored One holds up a flower, Kāśyapa smiles, and the World-Honored One says that he entrusts the treasury of the true teaching eye to Mahākāśyapa for transmission.
世尊 s1 o2 J/J39/J39nB450.xml:0481c01

世尊 s1 o2: Record of Chan Master Minshu; the complete raised case: the World-Honored One mounts the seat, Mañjuśrī strikes the block and announces, “Carefully observe the teaching king’s teaching; the teaching king’s teaching is thus,” and the World-Honored One immediately leaves the seat.

世尊 s1 o2 expected '敏樹禪師語錄': Record of Chan Master Minshu; the complete raised case: the World-Honored One mounts the seat, Mañjuśrī strikes the block and announces, “Carefully observe the teaching king’s teaching; the teaching king’s teaching is thus,” and the World-Honored One immediately leaves the seat.
世尊 s1 o3: Collected Ancient Cases of the Chan School; the outsider asks neither about speech nor no speech, the World-Honored One remains silent for a while, and the outsider praises him and departs.

世尊 s1 o3 expected '宗門拈古彙集': Collected Ancient Cases of the Chan School; the outsider asks neither about speech nor no speech, the World-Honored One remains silent for a while, and the outsider praises him and departs.

世尊 s1 o4 expected '五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)': Complete Lamp Collection, Zhenjing Kewen section; after stating that the World-Honored One held up a flower and Kāśyapa smiled, Kewen raises his staff, asks what the assembly will do, and strikes the incense table.

世尊 s1 o5 expected '湛然圓澄禪師語錄': Record of Chan Master Zhanran Yuancheng; he says, “The World-Honored One mounted the seat; you people also mount the seat. The World-Honored One was silent; you people also are silent.” This anchors later direct redeployment of the two public acts.
世尊 s1 o6 J/J26/J26nB185.xml:0582b14

世尊 s1 o6: The Chan record raises the birth case: the World-Honored One points one hand to heaven and one to earth, walks seven steps, looks to the four directions, and says, “above heaven and below heaven, I alone am honored” (天上天下，惟我獨尊).

世尊 s1 o6 expected '浮石禪師語錄': The Chan record raises the birth case: the World-Honored One points one hand to heaven and one to earth, walks seven steps, looks to the four directions, and says, “above heaven and below heaven, I alone am honored” (天上天下，惟我獨尊).

世尊 s1 o7: After reciting the World-Honored One's birth gesture and declaration, the record attributes to Yunmen: “if I had seen him at the time, I would have struck him dead with one blow and fed him to a dog,” followed by “valuing peace throughout the world” (貴圖天下太平). This preserves Yunmen's stated appraisal without assigning it to the World-Honored One.

世尊 s1 o7 expected '續傳燈錄': After reciting the World-Honored One's birth gesture and declaration, the record attributes to Yunmen: “if I had seen him at the time, I would have struck him dead with one blow and fed him to a dog,” followed by “valuing peace throughout the world” (貴圖天下太平). This preserves Yunmen's stated appraisal without assigning it to the World-Honored One.

世尊 s1 o8: In the woman-in-composure case, the World-Honored One commands Mañjuśrī to bring her out of composure. When Mañjuśrī cannot, he says, “below there is Wangming Bodhisattva, who can bring her out” (下方有罔明菩薩出得).

世尊 s1 o9: Walking with the assembly, the World-Honored One points to the ground and says, “a temple should be built here” (此處宜建梵剎). Indra plants a blade of grass and says, “the temple has already been built” (建梵剎已竟).

世尊 s1 o9 expected '大巍禪師竹室集': Walking with the assembly, the World-Honored One points to the ground and says, “a temple should be built here” (此處宜建梵剎). Indra plants a blade of grass and says, “the temple has already been built” (建梵剎已竟).
世尊 s1 o10: The World-Honored One displays a color-changing jewel to the five heavenly kings and asks, “what color does this jewel make?” (此珠而作何色). This anchors another display-and-question case.
